sex.evidence: 24 total with 12 male and 12 female mice/drug

dosing.evidence: All drugs were dissolved in 0.9% saline and administered subcutaneously (s.c.)... ED50 = 1.4 mg/kg

group_housing.evidence: group-housed for facility acclimation (3-5 per cage for 1-2 weeks)

day_night_flipped.evidence: housed in a 12:12 light-dark cycle (0700 local time = lights on)

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in modified open field chambers (cylindrical inserts, photobeam arrays, video recording) for a 30-min session following s.c. injection of test compound. HTRs quantified via video/software (CleverSys); locomotor activity and pre/post body temperature also recorded.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were dissolved in 0.9% saline and administered subcutaneously (s.c.)

setup_habituation.evidence: Each test session started with a short 5 min period of acclimation to the testing arenas

setup_restrain.evidence: returned to the test chambers for a 30 min session; locomotor activity recorded continuously

food_restriction.evidence: ad libitum access to food and water [in home cage]; testing in open field chambers without food/water

water_restriction.evidence: ad libitum access to food and water [in home cage]; testing in open field chambers without food/water

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were next injected s.c. with appropriate doses of test drug or vehicle and returned to the test chambers for a 30 min session

sample_size.evidence: 24 total with 12 male and 12 female mice/drug; n = 5-6 mice/dose

outcomes.summary: N-ethyl, N-propyl, N-allyl, N-isopropyl and N-benzyl norpsilocin analogues produced dose-related increases in HTR (ED50 = 1.1-3.3 mg/kg), with 4-HO-NALT producing the highest maximum effect (~77 events/30 min). Bulky N-n-butyl, N-tert-butyl and N-cyclohexyl analogues were inactive (ED50 > 30 mg/kg). All compounds produced hypothermia at the highest doses.
outcomes.statistics: ED50 (mg/kg s.c.): 4-HO-NET 1.4 (0.9-2.4); 4-HO-NPT 2.9 (2.7-3.1); 4-HO-NALT 1.1 (0.9-1.3); 4-HO-NiPT 3.3 (2.6-4.4); 4-HO-NBnT 1.2 (1.0-1.5); one-way ANOVA with Dunnett's posthoc (p < 0.05)
outcomes.evidence: all compounds produced dose-related increases in HTRs vs vehicle controls... dose-response curves exhibiting the typical inverted U shape

B1_num_measures.evidence: Mean total number of HTRs over the 30 min session, change in body temperature from pre to post session, and total distance traveled (cm)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: representative time-course plots for HTR activity of (B) 4-HO-NET, (C) 4-HO-NPT, and (D) 4-HO-NALT

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually; no social component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: quantify HTR activity via a commercially available software platform (Clever Sys Inc.) — proprietary video analysis; not pose-estimation/MoSeq/B-SOiD

E1_environment_type.evidence: open field chambers equipped with photobeam arrays, modified with cylindrical inserts

E2_shelter.evidence: Open field cylindrical chambers; no shelter.

E3_bedding.evidence: custom floor panels that facilitate video recordings; no bedding mentioned

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in test chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in test chamber.

E7_social_context.evidence: individual mice recorded in test chambers

D1_continuity.evidence: returned to the test chambers for a 30 min session

D3_recording_days.evidence: mice were tested only once every 1-2 weeks (each animal contributes one HTR session per drug condition)

D4_baseline.evidence: Only temperature was recorded at baseline; no pre-drug behavioural HTR recording reported.

D5_followup.evidence: No behavioural recording >=24 h after dosing.

judge_notes: Both candidates identified a single behavioural assay (HTR). Locomotor activity and body temperature were recorded in the same session/apparatus and are treated as additional measures within the HTR assay (counted under B1), not as separate assays.
CleverSys video analysis treated as automated quantification of a single behaviour (HTR) — not a multi-behaviour ML classifier (DeepLabCut/MoSeq/B-SOiD). Scored B7=0 per rubric.
B4 scored 0 because HTR is explicitly listed as non-ethological in the rubric.
D4 scored 0 — baseline temperature is physiological, not a behavioural baseline recording for HTR.
